subject: Next steps: GreenRidge trial handoff + API/SSO checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Lawson <mike@greenridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: GreenRidge trial handoff + API/SSO checklist

Hi Mike — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get your team running the 2-week trial: 

Summary of what we covered
- Goal: validate 95th percentile latency <= 220ms for infer calls at your dev scale (baseline traffic) and verify no PII persists in logs after session retention = 24h.
- Scope: chat + embeddings endpoints, sample dataset subset (100 customer transcripts), and a lightweight reranking flow.

Proposed success criteria (confirm/edit):
1) Latency: 95th %ile <= 220ms for chat generation at ~20 concurrent users.
2) Relevance: embeddings + reranker achieve at least 12% lift over baseline on your internal eval.
3) Security: SSO invites issued for 3 engineers + procurement signed DPA.

Concrete next steps and ownership
- Action: IP allowlist entries for test harness and CI runner
  Owner: GreenRidge infra (please provide IPs)
- Action: SSO invites (SAML) for engineering users
  Owner: Redwood (we'll send invites once SAML metadata is received)
- Action: API key for trial sandbox environment
  Owner: Redwood (Ben will provision)
- Action: Sample dataset ingest and evaluation plan
  Owner: GreenRidge data team (we can help with a small script)

Requests for you by EOD Wed 2027-02-16:
- Provide SAML metadata or Okta org URL
- Provide IP list to allowlist (CSV ok)
- Confirm DPA signer and counterparty for DocuSign

Attachments: GR_trial_plan_v1.pdf (trial plan), ip_allowlist_template.csv

I'll open a shared doc for the evaluation checklist and drop a DocuSign link for the DPA once we have the signer. If timings look off, we can shift the trial start by a week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

Questions / items we can commit to this week
- SAML metadata: we can provide Okta metadata.xml by Tue 2027-02-16 EOD.
- IP allowlist: infra will export the runner IPs by Tue (will use your template).
- DPA: procurement is set to sign; I'll confirm the signer today and share contact.

Additional asks
1) Can you provide a scoped API key that only allows access to the sandbox/model variant and logs to a separate tenant? We want to ensure no overlap with prod.
2) Who on your side will run the initial ingest script? We can stage the sample dataset in an S3 bucket and share presigned links.

Success criteria — looks good to me. One tweak: please add an item for billing estimate of the trial (approx tokens / cost) so procurement can see expected spend during the 2-week window.

We can do a quick sync Thurs to walk the infra folks through the SSO and allowlist steps.

Mike
Mike Lawson
Head of Platform, GreenRidge AI
mike@greenridge.ai

Thanks Mike — good questions. Quick answers and updates: 

- Scoped API key: Ben will provision a sandbox key scoped to the trial tenant and model variant (no prod access). The key will be created in a vault and only visible to the named trial engineers.
- Log isolation: we'll send the tenant ID and confirm log retention set to 24h for this trial.
- Ingest: Ava can run the initial ingest and provide the small ingestion script; please confirm where you'll host the sample (S3 presigned link is perfect).
- Billing estimate: I'm attaching a short estimator and an example token burn for a 2-week run — Ben will add numbers for your expected concurrency.

Proposed schedule
- Tue 2027-02-16: receive SAML metadata + IP list (GreenRidge)
- Wed 2027-02-17: Redwood sends SSO invites + provision API key
- Thu 2027-02-18: initial ingest + validation run; sync at 4pm PT to review first metrics

If that works, Ben will provision the key tomorrow morning and I’ll set up the 4pm sync invite for Thu.

Thanks,
Marissa
